kebab_example: aliyun slb create-load-balancer-tcp-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b6c719dfa08ex0000 --listener-port 80 --bandwidth='-1' --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLoadBalancerTCPListener

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

You can query the region ID from the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html list or by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401682.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html列表或通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2401682.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port used by the CLB instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。

取值范围：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The backend port used by the CLB instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

This parameter is required if you do not use a server group (do not specify vServerGroupId)
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例后端使用的端口。

取值范围：1~65535。

如果不使用服务器组（不指定vServerGroupId），则该参数必选
parameters.name: backend_server_port

fields.help_en: The tag key of the listener. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 监听的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value of the listener. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 监听的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The peak bandwidth of the listener. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

-1: For a pay-by-data-transfer Internet-facing SLB instance, you can set the peak bandwidth to -1, which specifies unlimited bandwidth.

1 to 5120: For a pay-by-bandwidth Internet-facing SLB instance, you can set the peak bandwidth for each listener. The sum of the peak bandwidth values of all listeners cannot exceed the peak bandwidth of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
监听的带宽峰值，单位：Mbps。取值：

-1：对于按流量计费的公网负载均衡实例，可以将带宽峰值设置为-1，即不限制带宽峰值。

1~5120： 对于按带宽计费的公网负载均衡实例，可以设置每个监听的带宽峰值，但所有监听的带宽峰值之和不能超过实例的带宽峰值
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

wrr (default): Backend servers with higher weights receive more requests through polling.

rr: Requests are distributed to backend servers in access sequence.

sch: Consistent hashing based on source IP addresses. Requests from the same source IP address are distributed to the same backend server.

tch: Consistent hashing based on the following parameters: source IP address, destination IP address, source port, and destination port. Requests that contain the same information based on the four factors are distributed to the same backend server.

Only high-performance instances support the sch and tch consistent hashing algorithms
parameters.help_zh:
调度算法。取值：

wrr（默认值）：权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。

rr：按照访问顺序依次将外部请求依序分发到后端服务器。

sch：基于源IP地址的一致性hash，相同的源地址会调度到相同的后端服务器。

tch：基于四元组的一致性hash（源IP+目的IP+源端口+目的端口），相同的流会调度到相同的后端服务器。

仅性能保障型实例支持sch和tch一致性hash算法
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period of session persistence. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 0 to 3600.

Default value: 0, which indicates that session persistence is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
会话保持的超时时间。单位：秒。

取值范围：0~3600。

默认值：0，表示关闭会话保持
parameters.name: persistence_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The connection timeout period. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 10 to 900
parameters.help_zh:
连接超时时间。单位：秒。

取值范围：10~900
parameters.name: established_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks that must occur before a backend server is declared healthy. The health check status of the backend server changes from fail to success.

Valid values: 2 to 10
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由fail判定为success。

取值范围： 2~10
parameters.name: healthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks that must occur before a backend server is declared unhealthy. The health check status of the backend server changes from success to fail.

Valid values: 2 to 10
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由success判定为fail。

取值范围：2~10
parameters.name: unhealthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The maximum timeout period for each health check response. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 300.

Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh:
每次健康检查响应的最大超时时间。单位：秒。

取值范围：1~300。

默认值：5
parameters.name: health_check_connect_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The port used for health checks.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

If this parameter is not set, the backend service port (BackendServerPort) is used for health checks
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查使用的端口。

取值范围：1~65535。

不设置此参数时，表示使用后端服务端口（BackendServerPort）
parameters.name: health_check_connect_port

parameters.help_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔。单位：秒。

取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: health_check_interval

parameters.help_en:
The domain name used for health checks. Valid values:

$_ip: the private IP address of the backend server. If you specify $_ip or do not specify this parameter, Server Load Balancer uses the private network IP address of each backend server as the domain name for health checks.

domain: The domain name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的域名。取值：

$_ip： 后端服务器的私网IP。当指定了IP或该参数未指定时，负载均衡会使用各后端服务器的私网IP当做健康检查使用的域名。

domain：域名长度为1~80，只能包含字母、数字、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: health_check_domain

parameters.help_en:
The URI used for health checks. The URI must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), percent signs (%), number signs (#), and ampersands (&). The URI cannot be only a forward slash (/) but must start with a forward slash (/).

You can configure this parameter when the TCP listener requires HTTP health checks. If this parameter is not configured, TCP health checks are performed
parameters.help_zh:
用于健康检查的URI。长度限制为1~80，只能使用字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、百分号（%）、井号（#）和and（&）这些字符。 URI不能只为正斜线（/），但必须以正斜线（/）开头。

当TCP监听需要使用HTTP健康检查时可配置此参数，如不配置则按TCP健康检查
parameters.name: health_check_uri

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP status code that indicates a Normal health check result. Separate multiple HTTP status codes with commas (,). Valid values:

http_2xx (default)
http_3xx
http_4xx
http_5xx
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查正常的HTTP状态码，多个状态码用半角逗号（,）分割。取值：

http_2xx（默认值）
http_3xx
http_4xx
http_5xx
parameters.name: health_check_http_code

parameters.help_en:
The health check type. Valid values:

tcp (default)
http
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查类型。取值：

tcp（默认值）
http
parameters.name: health_check_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vServer group
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟服务器组ID
parameters.name: vserver_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the primary/secondary server group.

You can specify only one of the vServer group ID and the primary/secondary server group ID
parameters.help_zh:
主备服务器组ID。

虚拟服务器组ID和主备服务器组ID只能选择一个
parameters.name: master_slave_server_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the access control list (ACL) bound to the listener.

This parameter is required when the AclStatus parameter is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
监听绑定的访问策略组ID。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，该参数必选
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of access control. Valid values:

white: Only requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are forwarded. Whitelists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to allow only specific IP addresses to access your service. Configuring a whitelist poses risks to your workloads. After a whitelist is configured, only the IP addresses in the whitelist can access the SLB listener. If a whitelist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the SLB listener forwards all requests.

black: All requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks in the selected access control policy group are denied. Blacklists are applicable to scenarios in which you want to deny access from specific IP addresses. If a blacklist is enabled but no IP address is added to the access control policy group, the SLB listener forwards all requests.

This parameter takes effect only when the AclStatus parameter is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制类型：

white： 仅转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的请求，白名单适用于只允许特定IP访问的场景。
设置白名单存在一定业务风险。
 
 一旦设置白名单，就只有白名单中的IP可以访问负载均衡监听。如果开启了白名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

black： 来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的所有请求都不会转发，黑名单适用于只限制某些特定IP访问的场景。

 如果开启了黑名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，该参数有效
parameters.name: acl_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access control. Valid values:

on: enabled.
off (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问控制功能。取值：

on：开启。
off（默认值）：不开启
parameters.name: acl_status

parameters.help_en:
The custom listener name.

The name must be 1 to 256 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义监听名称。

长度限制为1~256个字符，支持中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable connection draining. Valid values:

on: enabled.

off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启连接优雅中断。取值：

on：开启。

off：不开启
parameters.name: connection_drain

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period of connection draining. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 10 to 900.

This parameter is required when ConnectionDrain is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
设置连接优雅中断超时时间。单位：秒。

取值范围：10~900。

当ConnectionDrain取值为on时，该选项必选
parameters.name: connection_drain_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the Proxy Protocol to pass the client source address to the backend server. Valid values:

true: enabled.
false (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持通过Proxy Protocol协议携带客户端源地址到后端服务器。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: proxy_protocol_v2_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values:

on (default): enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：

on（默认值）：开启。
off：不开启
parameters.name: health_check_switch
